The property features three bedrooms, a modern kitchen, and a sunny balcony with city views. Available immediately, ideal for families or professionals seeking comfort and convenience.

mantine.modal_long_body:
This dialog contains a longer body to verify that the sheet scrolls internally instead of pushing the page. The heading and drag handle stay pinned at the top while this text area scrolls on its own.

When a listing is reported, our moderation team reviews the submission within one business day. You will receive a notification once a decision has been made, and the listing may be temporarily hidden while the review is in progress.

If you believe this report was submitted in error, you can contact support with the reference number provided in your confirmation email. Please include as much detail as possible so we can investigate quickly.

Thank you for helping keep the marketplace safe and trustworthy for everyone.

mantine.drawer_long_body:
This drawer contains a longer body to verify that the panel scrolls internally instead of resizing the page. The heading and drag handle stay pinned at the top while this text area scrolls on its own.

When filtering a long list of results, this panel lets you review every option without losing your place in the underlying page. Selections are applied only when you confirm, so browsing the list has no side effects.

If the list of options grows very long, the panel keeps the header visible so you always know what you are filtering, even after scrolling past the first several rows.

Thank you for taking the time to review these options carefully.
